bcc.definition: A hidden recipient. The other recipients cannot see that this person has been included.
bcc.example: I put the whole branch on BCC so nobody sees the full list.

life_cycle.definition: The whole journey of an animal, from the egg all the way back to eggs again.
life_cycle.example: A butterfly's life cycle has four stages.

pyjamas.definition: The soft clothes you wear in bed.
pyjamas.example: I put on my pyjamas before I brush my teeth.
